design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Tables: hairline rules, left-aligned text in first column, right-aligned numbers in data columns.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif italic, with a thick left rule in accent colour.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, background tint at 5% of accent colour.
Industry snapshot: stat strip with three numbers in large bold serif, growth bars as proportional horizontal bars.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The Indian construction sector is highly fragmented and working-capital intensive, contributing roughly 8% to India's GDP.
industry_snapshot.rationale: Three headline numbers and a growth bar give the reader the industry context without a paragraph of prose.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: This concentration is the single most important fact about the business.
pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway alone accounts for 52% of the orders on hand.

sidebars.body_markdown: **Fresh issue:** 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at a price to be determined.[^drhp-p29] **Use of proceeds:** ₹1,130 lakhs for working capital; remainder for general corporate purposes (amount not disclosed).[^drhp-p48] **Lead manager:** Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited.[^drhp-p31] **Registrar:** Bigshare Services Private Limited.[^drhp-p31] **Pre-issue promoter holding:** 90.949%.[^drhp-p100]
sidebars.rationale: Condenses the key offer terms into a scannable box, freeing the prose for analysis.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: A B Infrabuild's financials over the five years from FY2014 to FY2018 tell a story of a business under pressure, with a dramatic recovery in the final year that warrants scrutiny.
tables.footnote: Source: Restated financial statements, DRHP pages 26, 27, and 111.[^drhp-p26][^drhp-p27][^drhp-p111]
tables.rationale: Five-year trend of revenue decline and profit spike is the core financial story; a table lets the reader see the pattern at a glance.
tables.title: Restated financial summary (₹ in lakhs)

tables.after_paragraph: The DRHP includes a section on accounting ratios and peer comparison, but the names and financials of peer companies are not available in the extracted data.
tables.rationale: EPS and RoNW mirror the profit trajectory; NAV provides a book-value anchor for valuation when the issue price is set.
